module: Drift detection engine. For each tracked vehicle (one state per vehId, player 0's vehicle is tracked automatically), computes every frame the drift angle, oversteer, speed, distance to walls (front/rear raycasts), crashes and spinouts, and decides whether the vehicle is drifting. Manages the driftActiveData (drift in progress) and driftChainActiveData (drift chain) structures and emits the hooks onDriftChainStarted, onDriftStatusChanged, onDriftTransition, onDriftActiveDataFinished, onDriftCompleted, onDriftCrash and onDriftSpinout that scoring, display, quickMessages, statistics, etc. consume. This is the module to read to know whether the player is drifting and at what angle.
usage:
if gameplay_drift_drift.getIsDrifting() then
  local d = gameplay_drift_drift.getDriftActiveData()
  print(d.currDegAngle, gameplay_drift_drift.getAirSpeed())
end
notes: Drift condition (isDrifting): oversteer detected, no reverse "cheesing" (angle > 120° with smoothed acceleration > -0.07), minAngle (7°) < angle < maxAngle (165°), average speed of the reference points > minAirSpeed (4 km/h), not in walking mode, vehicle on the ground, no failure cooldown (1.65 s), no reset timer (0.1 s), no crash in progress.
Units: angles in degrees; getAirSpeed and kphAirSpeed in km/h (vel * 3.6); getVehVel returns the normalized DIRECTION of the velocity (velDir), not the speed; distances in meters.

A drift chain ends (onDriftCompleted hook) when the confirmation time runs out with no drift and the cached score is > 0; this time ranges from 1.2 s (combo <= 5) to 2.25 s (combo >= 20). Cascade zones reset this time to the maximum.
The get* functions without vehId use player 0's vehicle if it is tracked, otherwise any tracked vehicle; with an unknown vehId they return nil/false/0.

Crash: onVehicleCrashStarted marks the vehicle as crashed only if its cached score is > 0; the onDriftCrash hook is emitted 0.3 s later. Spinout: speed < 1.5 km/h with angle > 110° after a drift with cached score > 0.

Walls are detected with castRayStatic over wallDetectionLength = 3 m, from the front and rear of the vehicle, with blue noise to sweep the width; the values are closestWallDistanceFront/Rear in driftActiveData.

driftActiveData: {driftDuration, driftDistance, closestWallDistanceFront/Rear, currDegAngle, direction ("left"/"right"), totalDriftAngle, totalDriftTime, angleVelocity, startPos, lastPos, score, totalAngles, totalSpeeds, totalPerformanceFactors, totalSteps, ...}. driftChainActiveData: {totalDriftDistance, totalDriftTime, rightDrifts, leftDrifts, chainedDrifts, currentCircleDrift = {totalAngle}}.
No detection during the firstDrive tutorial, when walking, when paused, when dtSim <= 0, nor in multiseat outside the inSplitscreen context.
simulateADrift(data) (audio debug) forces angle, speed, wall distance and simulated crash; passing nil stops the simulation.
The driftDuration field of driftActiveData is never updated (stays 0): use totalDriftTime or getCurrentDriftDuration.
getVehCorners returns a new table of 4 shared vec3 (reused every frame, do not modify them).

addTrackedVehicle.desc: Adds a vehicle to the drift tracking (creates its state) and returns that state. With opts.playerId, associates the vehicle with a player and removes any other vehicle tracked for that same player.

removeTrackedVehicle.desc: Removes a vehicle from the drift tracking and from the crash tracking (gameplay_util_crashDetection).

getTrackedVehicles.desc: Returns the table of drift states, keyed by vehId (live table).

getPlayerIdForVehicle.desc: Returns the player id associated with a tracked vehicle.

setVehId.desc: Tracks only this vehicle: removes all the other tracked vehicles then adds it.

newVehId.desc: Id of the vehicle to track.

getVehId.desc: Returns the id of the main tracked vehicle (player 0 if possible).

getPlVeh.desc: Returns the main tracked vehicle object.

getVehData.desc: Returns the vehicle's map.objects data (pos, vel, dirVec, ...).

getVehPos.desc: Returns the vehicle position tracked by the module.

getVehVel.desc: Returns the normalized direction of the vehicle's velocity (velDir), not its magnitude.

getAirSpeed.desc: Returns the vehicle speed in km/h (velocity norm * 3.6).

getVehCorners.desc: Returns the 4 corners of the bounding box used for the raycasts (front right, rear right, rear left, front left), at raycastHeight.

doesPlHaveVeh.desc: Indicates whether the tracked vehicle has valid map data.

getIsDrifting.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle is drifting.

getIsOverSteering.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle is oversteering (front and center go the same way as the rear).

getIsOverMinSpeedForDrift.desc: Indicates whether the average speed of the reference points exceeds minAirSpeed (4 km/h).

getIsInTheAir.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle is not on its wheels.

getIsCrashing.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle is crashing (gameplay_util_crashDetection).

getDriftActiveData.desc: Returns the data of the current drift (nil if there is none).

getDriftChainActiveData.desc: Returns the data of the current drift chain (nil if none).

getDriftChainChainedDrifts.desc: Returns the number of drifts chained in the current chain.

returns.desc: Number of drifts, 0 if no chain.

getCurrDegAngleSigned.desc: Returns the current drift angle in degrees, signed (the sign gives the side).

getAngleDiff.desc: Returns the change in angle of the velocity direction since the previous frame (degrees), computed during a drift.

getCurrDriftCompletedTime.desc: Returns the remaining fraction (0..1) of the drift chain's confirmation time (1 = the drift just happened, 0 = confirmed).

getDistSinceLastFrame.desc: Returns the distance traveled since the previous frame, in meters.

getCurrentDriftDuration.desc: Returns the duration of the current drift (totalDriftTime), 0 if not drifting.

getDriftOptions.desc: Returns the table of detection settings: minAngle 7, maxAngle 165, allowDonut, allowTightDrifts, raycastHeight 0.5, wallDetectionLength 3, baseDriftCompleteTime 1.2, failPointsCooldown 1.65, minAirSpeed 4, maxWasDriftingTime 4, crashDamageThreshold 150, etc. Live table, modifiable.

setAllowDonut.desc: Enables/disables taking donuts into account (driftOptions.allowDonut), read by the cascade zones.

setBalanceMode.desc: Enables "balance" mode: while it is active the confirmation time stays frozen at 1 and the drift chain is not concluded.

reset.desc: Resets a vehicle's drift state (or all if vehId is nil): removes the drift/chain in progress, resets the crash data.

simulateADrift.desc: Enables a drift simulation for audio debug; nil stops it.

getGC.desc: Returns the amount of garbage measured by the profiler.

returns.desc: nil as long as general debug has never been active.

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Returns {default=true, canBeChanged=true} for the drift debug window.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: automatically tracks player 0's vehicle if nothing is tracked, then updates the detection for each tracked vehicle. Skipped during firstDrive, walking, pause or dtSim <= 0.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook: a player's vehicle change; removes the old vehicle if it belonged to this player and tracks the new one (reset timer 0.1 s).

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: removes the destroyed vehicle from the tracking.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: level end; empties the list of tracked vehicles.

onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished.desc: Hook: a cascade zone is completed; resets the drift chain's confirmation time to the maximum.

onDriftContextChanged.desc: Hook: on a context change, adds the vehicles to the crash tracking (except in inAnotherMissionType, where they are removed from it).

onDriftChallengeFinished.desc: Hook: end of a drift challenge; emits onDriftCompleted for the chains in progress and onDriftActiveDataFinished for the drifts in progress.

onDriftPlVehReset.desc: Hook: vehicle put back in place; resets its state and activates a 0.1 s reset timer during which it does not drift.

onVehicleCrashStarted.desc: Hook: crash start detected by gameplay_util_crashDetection; marks the vehicle as crashed if its cached score is > 0 (outside pause, freeze, walking).

onSerialize.desc: Hook: saves the debug checkbox before Lua reload.
